leadText: Chinami Nishimura (Japanese: 西村ちなみ Nishimura Chinami) is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Chinami Nishimura (Japanese: 西村ちなみ Nishimura Chinami) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Nishimura was born on November 18, 1970 in , . She has provided the voices for many and characters of the day in . Her most notable role is all of the Officer Jennys from Kanto, the Orange Islands, Johto, Hoenn, and Sinnoh, before she passed the roles on to other voice actresses. Nishimura is currently affiliated with the talent agency .
